name: 脸被rua扁了
caption: 放开我的脸
framing: Extreme face close-up, cheeks dominating the frame; two external hands enter from the side edges with wrists continuing off-screen.
action: Two outside hands gently squeeze the character's cheeks inward and ease the pressure in a slow repeating squeeze-release cycle. The cheek outline visibly compresses into a soft mochi shape and springs back, while the tiny mouth alternates between a squashed pout and a stubborn little w. The hands stay in contact, fingers anatomically connected, never crossing the eyes. The character's own two small fists remain below the chin. Wet glossy eyes keep their original colors and look at the viewer with adorably offended patience. Hair tips follow only the cheek and head movement; the camera and torso do not bob.

name: 门后悄悄吃瓜
caption: 我就看看
framing: Asymmetric head-and-shoulders view behind a door at frame right; the door edge is a fixed vertical occluder and white space remains at frame left.
action: The character repeatedly leans the head and one shoulder a short distance out from behind the door and retreats halfway behind it. Two small hands remain attached to the door edge, sliding only slightly. The curious eyes glance toward the empty space on the left and return to the viewer, with a secretive tiny smile. The body stays hidden; no legs or standing pose are introduced. The door is completely still. The hair follows the sideways head arc with a small delay. This is a slow furtive peek-and-hide cycle with readable occlusion, not a dance or a zoom.

name: 键盘已经冒烟
caption: 我跟你拼了
framing: Three-quarter waist-up desk view; large expressive face above a visible keyboard, laptop anchored at frame left, both hands unobstructed.
action: The character furiously types on the keyboard with quick alternating left and right hand taps, fingertips staying over separate groups of keys. Tiny wrists lift and strike down in a rapid uneven rhythm while the forearms remain connected to the sleeves. The eyebrows stay sharply furrowed and the little clenched mouth shows comic frustration. The head leans toward the laptop without bouncing vertically. The keyboard, laptop and desk remain solid and fixed; only the tapping hands, reactive sleeve cuffs and a small persistent frustration puff move. Keep the same irritated face throughout the ongoing typing loop.

name: 被窝拒绝营业
caption: 不存在的我
framing: Close horizontal curled-up view on a pillow; a blanket mound fills the lower frame, the sleepy face peeks above its edge and a moon lamp sits at frame left.
action: Lying still on the pillow, the character slowly pulls the blanket edge up to cover the eyes, pauses shyly behind the cloth for a moment, and lowers it just enough to reveal the same sleepy half-lidded eyes again. Both little hands continuously grip the same cloth edge. The blanket folds bend naturally around the fingers, while the head stays supported by the pillow. A tiny breathing rise travels through the blanket mound. The moon lamp brightness and the pillow remain constant. Repeat this small hide-and-peek gesture without sitting up, opening the blanket fully or revealing the body.

name: 越理越乱救命
caption: 等一下等一下
framing: Seated knees-up view with a large flustered face, two boots and a loose USB cable clearly visible; one hand holds the cable end and the other reaches outward.
action: The seated character gives the held USB cable a short hesitant tug and releases it, making the loose cable loops outside the boots wobble and settle. The two boots make tiny alternating sideways wiggles but stay inside the same loose coil. The reaching hand flutters a small helpless plea while the face maintains raised inner eyebrows, watery eyes and a wobbly open mouth. Keep a single continuous cable with the same visible connectors and no new knots. The cable never tightens around skin or the neck. Repeat the frustrated tug-and-release attempt without escaping, standing or changing the scene.

name: 全体注意听我说
caption: 集合啦
framing: Dynamic waist-up three-quarter view; a big megaphone points toward frame left, the face remains fully readable beside it and the second hand cups near the mouth.
action: The character repeatedly opens the mouth into a wide cheerful calling shape and relaxes it, leaning a few centimeters toward the megaphone with each silent call. One hand keeps a secure grip on the same megaphone handle and the other remains cupped beside the mouth. The horn makes a tiny attached wrist-driven tilt, while three existing comic sound rays pulse in size without multiplying. The eyebrows lift with comic urgency. The horn and face never merge. Hair ends and sleeve hems trail the small forward lean. Maintain this emphatic calling loop without walking, jumping or adding written words.

name: 喝口水压压惊
caption: 来，喝一口
framing: Intimate upper-body close-up with the face large and a cup held by both hands in the lower foreground; maintain the reference composition.
action: The character gently offers the cup toward the viewer and draws it back a short distance in a repeating inviting gesture, both hands firmly holding opposite sides of the same cup. The liquid and ice sway subtly in response, without spilling or changing quantity. A warm smile opens slightly and settles, and the eyes blink softly while keeping their original left-right colors. The head makes a small friendly tilt rather than a vertical bounce. The cup, straw, fingers and wrists remain clearly separated and physically connected. Keep the close composition and do not reveal a full standing body.

name: 最后一口不给你
caption: 想吃？不给
framing: Seated at a low side table, chin supported by one hand; the other hand holds a small plate with one strawberry near the viewer.
action: With one cheek resting on the same supporting hand, the character teasingly offers the strawberry plate a short distance toward the viewer and pulls it back toward the chest. The other elbow and wrist drive this small horizontal arc while the plate remains level and the single strawberry stays firmly on it. The eyes narrow into a mischievous smile during the retreat and soften on the next offer. The cheek squashes gently against the supporting palm. The table, seated legs and hair behind the body stay grounded. Repeat the playful offer-and-withdraw gesture without eating or duplicating the strawberry.

name: 笑到坐不住了
caption: 笑不活了
framing: Large seated three-quarter view, one hand bracing against the floor and the other on the belly, both boot soles readable; preserve the reference's playful diagonal composition.
action: The character laughs so hard that the seated torso rocks backward and forward in short irregular chuckles. One hand remains planted on the floor as support and the other holds the belly. The two bent legs make small alternating happy kicks while the hips stay on the floor. Closed laughing eyes, wide joyful mouth and tiny tears at the outer corners remain readable. Long hair spreads on the floor and shifts with the torso, sleeve cuffs follow the moving arms. The boots keep their shape and both legs remain distinct. Continue the seated giggling loop without standing up, hopping or turning around.

name: 让我康康细节
caption: 让我康康
framing: Seated or crouched close three-quarter view with a magnifying glass held over one eye; the face and lens are the focal point, preserving the reference pose.
action: The character slides the magnifying glass a short distance across the same eye and back, creating a playful lens magnification of that eye while the other eye squints with curiosity. The lens stays circular, the handle remains held by one connected hand and the face never melts into the glass. The head leans slightly with the inspecting motion and returns, keeping the same seated support and body position. A curious eyebrow rises and relaxes. Hair and the attached ornament follow gently. Repeat the small investigative sweep with no camera zoom, walking or body bounce.
